usageNotes: Use this endpoint to pull raw time-series metrics for nodes, VMs, and containers across the cluster; requires Sys.Audit on /. By default it returns only the most recent sample set — pass `history: true` together with a `start-time` Unix epoch to bound the window and avoid very large payloads. When diagnosing a single node, combine `local-only: true` or `node-list` to reduce response size.

examples.summary: Fetch metrics for two specific nodes since a point in time

tips: Response items are sorted by timestamp ascending; if you need only the latest snapshot, omit `history` and `start-time`.
The `id` field encodes object type and identity (e.g. 'node/pve01', 'qemu/100', 'lxc/200') — parse the prefix to filter by resource type.
Metric `type` values follow RRDtool semantics: gauge is an instantaneous value, counter/derive are cumulative (need delta calculation for rate).
Using `history: true` without `start-time` returns the full available retention window, which can be very large on active clusters.
